notes.subject: זרמתם
notes.rationale: 'O ba neleditse' (you flooded them away) — KJV/JPS 'carriest away as with a flood' vs BSB 'whisk away in their sleep'; the verb זרם means to gush as water

notes.subject: boroko
notes.rationale: שנה is sleep as a state; 'ba nna boroko' renders 'they become a sleep', i.e. fleeting as a dream

notes.subject: jaaka lera ba a feta
notes.rationale: second reading: 'in the morning it changes/sprouts like grass' (YLT 'as grass he changeth'), attaching יחלף to grass springing up

translation: O ba neleditse ba nna boroko; mo mosong jaaka lera ba a feta.
